column:forecast_runs.created_at: timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column:forecast_runs.generated_at: timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column:forecast_runs.status: character varying(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS'::character varying
constraint:forecast_runs.forecast_runs_s: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SUCCESS'::character varying, 'NOT_ENOUGH_HISTORY'::character varying, 'TOO_FEW'::character varying, 'ERROR'::character varying])::text[])))
constraint:transactions.transactions_out: CHECK ((((outcome IS NULL) AND (disapproval_reason IS NULL) AND (disapproval_notice_given IS NULL)) OR (((outcome)::text = 'GRANTED'::text) AND (disapproval_reason IS NULL) AND (disapproval_notice_given IS NULL)) OR (((outcome)::text = 'DISAPPROVED'::text) AND (disapproval_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(btrim(disapproval_reason)) >= 1) AND (char_length(btrim(disapproval_reason)) <= 1000)) AND (disapproval_notice_given IS TRUE))))
index:forecast_runs.forecast_runs_office: CREATE INDEX forecast_runs_office_idx ON public.forecast_runs USING btree (office_id, generated_at DESC)
index:forecast_runs.forecast_runs_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX forecast_runs_pkey ON public.forecast_runs USING btree (id)

index:forecast_runs.forecast_runs_status: CREATE INDEX forecast_runs_status_idx ON public.forecast_runs USING btree (status)
